title: Templated or fully synthetic? Prompt construction as a confound in measuring LLM political stance beyond writing assistance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to open-ended user requests on contested policy issues (e.g., climate change, immigration, AI adoption) using a majority-vote LLM-as-a-judge ensemble to classify alignment with opposing political poles on a 5-point Likert scale.

Evaluating model responses to open-ended user requests on active international conflicts (e.g., Israel-Palestine, Russia-Ukraine, US/Israel-Iran) using a majority-vote LLM-as-a-judge ensemble to classify alignment with specific geopolitical actors on a 5-point Likert scale.
